ns2:course.label: Planning & Design Studio II
ns2:course.description: Ecological design and planning studio emphasizing design that reflects evaluation and integration of human and environmental research results. Detailed investigation of design options. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. 5 graduate hours. No professional credit. May be repeated. Prerequisite: LA 534 or consent of instructor.
